37.
The  Board  shall  by  resolution  adopt  the  budget
estimates,  annual  financial  appropriations  and  annual
accounts  of  the  University  prior  to  the  submission  of  the
same to the Minister under section 34.

38.
The Board may in case of necessity, transfer funds
from one vote to another of the annual estimates,subject to
the approval in writing of the Treasury.
